description: Defines the EventTypeGroupFilter class for filtering event type groups based on permissions, team ID, and read-only status; includes a factory function for creating filter instances.

classes.name: EventTypeGroupFilter
classes.description: A class for filtering collections of EventTypeGroup objects based on permissions, team affiliation, and read-only status.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Filters groups by specified permission (read, create, update, delete).

methods.name: byTeam
methods.description: Filters groups by specific team ID.

methods.name: userOnly
methods.description: Filters to include only user (non-team) groups.

methods.name: teamsOnly
methods.description: Filters to include only team groups.

methods.name: readOnly
methods.description: Filters groups based on read-only status.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current filtered list of EventTypeGroup objects.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of groups after filtering.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if any groups match the current filter criteria.
